note: sourceBrand.patterns: every pattern below was grepped from the real pages in .recon/pages (assert-checked at authoring time) or CLONE_SPEC.md; none is invented. Used by schema/semantic_validate.py in generated mode only. Matching is case-insensitive on whole words unless the pattern is a regex.

CTA.judgement: Generic UI labels that also occur on the source (Get in touch, More works, Credits) are NOT blocked; only labels distinctive to this site are.

COPY.note: sha1[:16] of every 6-word window of visible text on all 39 source pages (EN+FR), normalised (lowercase, punctuation stripped). A generated string sharing any window is source copy.

URL.generatedAllowed: Absolute links in generated mode must use reserved domains: *.example, *.invalid, example.com, example.org, example.net; in-page anchors (#...) and site-relative paths are allowed.

STORE.note: The source shows no store marks (grep of all 39 pages: 0 hits). The rule still blocks store marks/links in generated mode so a generator cannot add a fake one.

MEDIA.generatedAllowed: Generated media refs use generated://, placeholder:// or user:// schemes.

fictionalPhone.note: Generated tel: links must use a range reserved for fiction: France +33 1 99 00 xx xx (ARCEP) or North America +1 555-01xx.
